Title: User can request password reset via Forgot password link
Preconditions: User is on the login page and has a registered account
Steps:
1. Navigate to the login page
2. Click 'Forgot password?' link
3. Enter registered email address
4. Click 'Submit' or 'Send reset link'
Expected Result: User sees a generic success message indicating reset instructions have been sent; reset email is delivered within 2 minutes

Title: Reset email is sent to registered email within 2 minutes
Preconditions: User has a registered account and has requested a password reset
Steps:
1. Request password reset with registered email
2. Check email inbox (and spam folder) within 2 minutes
Expected Result: Password reset email arrives within 2 minutes containing a valid reset link

Title: Reset link is valid for 30 minutes
Preconditions: User has received a password reset email with a reset link
Steps:
1. Wait 29 minutes after email delivery
2. Click the reset link
3. Enter valid new password meeting requirements
4. Submit new password
Expected Result: Password reset succeeds; user can log in with new password

Title: Reset link expires after 30 minutes
Preconditions: User has received a password reset email with a reset link
Steps:
1. Wait 31 minutes after email delivery
2. Click the reset link
Expected Result: Reset link is rejected with an 'expired' or 'invalid link' error; user is prompted to request a new reset

Title: Generic message shown for unregistered email (no enumeration)
Preconditions: User is on the forgot password page
Steps:
1. Enter an email address not registered in the system
2. Click 'Submit'
Expected Result: Same generic success message is shown as for registered email; no indication that email is unregistered

Title: Reset link page allows setting new password with valid complexity
Preconditions: User has clicked a valid, unexpired reset link
Steps:
1. On reset password page, enter new password: 'Passw0rd!' (8 chars, 1 number, 1 special char)
2. Confirm password
3. Click 'Reset Password'
Expected Result: Password is accepted; user sees success message and is redirected to login page

Title: New password rejected if less than 8 characters
Preconditions: User is on the reset password page via valid reset link
Steps:
1. Enter new password: 'Pas1!' (6 chars)
2. Confirm password
3. Click 'Reset Password'
Expected Result: Validation error: password must be at least 8 characters

Title: New password rejected if missing number
Preconditions: User is on the reset password page via valid reset link
Steps:
1. Enter new password: 'Password!' (no number)
2. Confirm password
3. Click 'Reset Password'
Expected Result: Validation error: password must include at least one number

Title: New password rejected if missing special character
Preconditions: User is on the reset password page via valid reset link
Steps:
1. Enter new password: 'Password1' (no special char)
2. Confirm password
3. Click 'Reset Password'
Expected Result: Validation error: password must include at least one special character

Title: New password rejected if password and confirmation do not match
Preconditions: User is on the reset password page via valid reset link
Steps:
1. Enter new password: 'Passw0rd!'
2. Enter confirmation: 'Passw0rd!2'
3. Click 'Reset Password'
Expected Result: Validation error: passwords do not match

Title: All existing sessions are logged out after successful password reset
Preconditions: User has active sessions on multiple devices/browsers
Steps:
1. Complete password reset via reset link
2. Attempt to access protected page on another device/browser where user was previously logged in
Expected Result: User is redirected to login page; session is invalidated

Title: Confirmation email sent after successful password change
Preconditions: User has completed password reset successfully
Steps: 1. Check email inbox (and spam folder) after password reset
Expected Result: Confirmation email received stating password was changed successfully

Title: Reset link cannot be reused after successful use
Preconditions: User has successfully reset password using a reset link
Steps: 1. Click the same reset link again (or refresh the reset confirmation page)
Expected Result: Link is rejected with 'already used' or 'invalid link' error; user cannot reset password again with same link

Title: Rate limit: max 3 reset requests per email per hour
Steps:
1. Request password reset 3 times within 10 minutes using same email
2. Attempt a 4th request within the same hour
Expected Result: First 3 requests succeed (or show generic success); 4th request shows rate limit error (e.g., 'Too many requests, try again later')

Title: Rate limit resets after 1 hour
Preconditions: User has hit the rate limit (3 requests in last hour)
Steps:
1. Wait 61 minutes after first request
2. Request password reset again
Expected Result: Request succeeds; rate limit window has reset

Title: Forgot password link is accessible from login page
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Steps:
1. Verify 'Forgot password?' link is visible and clickable
2. Click the link
Expected Result: User is navigated to the password reset request page
